summary.goal: Handle all error and failure states with appropriate UI across tree, conversation, and status bar.

acceptance_criteria.description: Step failure: tree shows ✗ with error summary, conversation shows system event, Interviewer summarizes options, reply bar gets pending decision
Run failure: tree shows ⚠ (paused) on all running steps, conversation shows recovery options via MultipleChoiceInput ([Resume] [Restart from failed] [Cancel run])
SSE connection loss: tree shows stale indicator ('last updated X ago'), status bar shows connection indicator, exponential backoff reconnection for all 3 streams
On SSE reconnect: forge SSE replays via Last-Event-ID, tree reconciles from fresh API fetch
Agent stuck (normal): Interviewer asks agent what it needs, surfaces question through attention system
Agent stuck (system): forge detects via timeout, auto-restart attempted, escalated to user if retry fails
Status bar agent avatar turns red for blocked agents, fades after user acknowledges

observations: Error states span all three columns and the status bar
The existing SSE hooks (useSessionEvents, usePlanEvents, useRunEvents) already have exponential backoff with max 5 retries — keep this
Forge SSE supports Last-Event-ID for missed event replay
The Interviewer handles step failure communication — it summarizes the error and offers options conversationally
Two types of 'stuck': normal (needs info, handled via attention system) and system (looping/crashed, handled by forge timeout)
Visual indicators: tree uses symbols (✗ fail, ⚠ paused), status bar uses color (red avatar), connection indicator appears on disconnect
questions: Should step failures pause the entire run or just that step?
Do we auto-retry failed steps or always ask user?
Should connection loss show a toast or just inline indicators?

steps.title: Step failure UI
steps.description: Copy error state pattern from planner-ui step editor. When step_failed event received via useRunEvents: tree shows ✗ symbol with error summary tooltip (StepNode component), conversation receives system event ('┊ Step failed · [step title] · [error summary]'), Interviewer summarizes error and offers options ([Retry] [Skip] [Investigate]), reply bar adds pending decision item. Red status until acknowledged.

steps.title: Run failure UI
steps.description: When run_failed event received: tree shows ⚠ (paused) on all running steps (not failed — paused for recovery), conversation shows system event ('┊ Run paused due to failure'), Interviewer message with MultipleChoiceInput showing recovery options ([Resume] [Restart from failed] [Cancel run]). All agent avatars in status bar fade to paused state (gray).

steps.title: Connection loss UI
steps.description: Copy SSE reconnection pattern from existing hooks (useSessionEvents, usePlanEvents, useRunEvents — all have exponential backoff max 5 retries). On disconnect: tree shows 'last updated X ago' indicator on running steps (subtle, level 1 attention), status bar shows connection indicator (normally hidden). Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s max. No toast, inline indicators only.

steps.title: SSE reconnect handling
steps.description: On SSE reconnect after disconnect: forge SSE supports Last-Event-ID header for missed event replay (copy pattern from existing forge integration). After receiving replayed events, fetch fresh state from GET /api/projects/:id to reconcile tree (steps, status, progress). Update ProjectTree state from fresh data. Ideation and planner SSE may not support Last-Event-ID — handle via fresh fetch.

steps.title: Agent stuck states
steps.description: Two types: Normal stuck (agent needs info/decision) — agent sends question via relay, Interviewer receives, surfaces via attention system (copy question pipeline from planner-ui useQuestionNotifications). System stuck (looping, crashed) — forge detects via timeout (no progress for N seconds), auto-restart agent once via forge orchestrator, if restart fails escalate to user via Interviewer message. Status bar: normal stuck → yellow avatar (needs_input), system stuck → red avatar (blocked). Copy forge timeout detection pattern.

architect.sse_reconnect: existing exponential backoff pattern with max 5 retries
architect.stuck_detection: normal via agent question, system via forge timeout
architect.visual_indicators: tree: ✗ fail / ⚠ paused, status bar: red avatar, connection indicator

run_failure.conversation: system event: 'Run paused due to failure'
run_failure.status_bar: all agent avatars fade to paused state

sse_connection_loss.on_reconnect: fetch fresh state from API, reconcile tree

agent_stuck_normal.interviewer: receives question, surfaces via attention system

agent_stuck_system.detection: forge timeout (no progress for N seconds)
agent_stuck_system.escalation: if restart fails, surface to user via Interviewer
